There's been no settlement. Uh, so nothing has changed other than when he's going to be tried. And I, I don't think they put him on the exempt list just because the trial was in November. So I think, again, it's totally up to the league, but he is cleared to travel and has been cleared to travel in some cases before this. But the next hearing is, I think, a pre-trial hearing in February. Yeah, late February. Yeah, totally up to the league, though. So, yeah, they could announce... Like he could still be suspended after a trial or whatever happens in the case, even a settlement, he could be suspended. Thank you, fellas. We'll see you. All right, always good to have Jeff Legwald with us here on the show.

title: BONUS: Dan Wiederer shares thoughts on Bears blowout loss to Packers on 104.3 The Score
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer joined Leila Rahimi & Mark Grote on Chicago's 104.3 The Score to sort through the aftermath of the Bears horrible game in Green Bay. Wiederer feels that quarterback Caleb Williams' absence is being felt more and more with each passing week as he has missed the last three contests with a hamstring injury.
